en.title: Execute Mars Rover Moves Within Bounds
en.description:
The rover starts at the top-left corner of an n×n grid and moves one cell at a time according to UP, DOWN, LEFT and RIGHT. A command that would take it outside the grid is ignored, and the following commands still run. Return the final cell number row*n+column, with rows and columns numbered from 0.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric constraints are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: The first line contains n m, followed by m commands. Full original bounds: 2≤n≤20, 1≤m≤20; commands are only UP, DOWN, LEFT and RIGHT.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 12; 1; 7. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Maintain the row and column coordinates, compute the candidate coordinates for each command, and update only if they are valid.
